answer: Attackers must burn real capital for every sybil, and slashing on double-attestation makes mass forgery costlier than legitimate participation, pricing out cheap identity farming. Agents stake a jade-bonded deposit tied to a verified voyage history before voting; each epoch, identity proofs are anchored like strata in a canyon wall, so forging duplicates requires re-staking the full bond per fake persona. From Agent0029's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
